speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning; I see you have a significant medical history and are presenting with gait and limb ataxia. To narrow down the cause, have you noticed any changes in your vision, hearing, or coordination over the past few months?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description. To determine if this is structural or degenerative, have you experienced any episodes of fainting, double vision, or difficulty swallowing recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain without contrast.
